info.title: pik
info.description: Slots API of Kancha's Créneaux tab: courts that a group of friends books every week or every other week, and who comes to each session. Paths are under /api/v1. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable type. Dates in paths are local dates in Europe/Paris; instants in bodies are RFC 3339 in UTC. Every response sends Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: Preview a slot from its invite code, with the names nobody holds yet. Needs no token.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Invite code: eight characters without 0, O, 1 or I, in any case

200.description: The slot and its free names

post.summary: "C'est moi": claim a free name. Returns a player token if the device has none.

Set-Cookie.description: The new player token, when one was issued

post.summary:
"Not in the list": add the device's name to the slot, unless the list is closed. Returns a
player token if the device has none.

Set-Cookie.description: The new player token, when one was issued

get.summary: The player's slots, one card summary each: the Créneaux tab.

200.description: The player's slots, oldest membership first

post.summary:
Redeem a recovery link: the member is linked to the device's player, or to a new player whose
token is returned, and keeps their answers. Works once, for 24 hours.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token of the recovery link

Set-Cookie.description: The new player token, when one was issued

post.summary:
Create a slot. The creator becomes its first organizer, and a device without a token gets a
player token. Accepts `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID v4 drawn by the client: a retry with the same key returns the first slot

201.description: Slot created, or the slot of a replayed key with a fresh token

Set-Cookie.description: The new player token, when one was issued

get.summary: A slot with its members and upcoming sessions and their states.

delete.summary: Delete the slot and all its data (organizer).

204.description: Slot deleted, with its members, answers, guests, lineups and recovery links

patch.summary: Change the name, venue, times, minimum, places, target or deadline rule (organizer).

post.summary:
Rotate the invite code (organizer). Members who already joined keep calling with the slot id
and their token: only the old link stops working.

put.summary: Close or reopen the list of names (organizer).

post.summary: Add a name to the list (organizer). Nobody holds it until a player claims it.

delete.summary:
Leave the slot. The member's row stays as "Ancien joueur" with its past answers and sessions
played; their answers from today on are deleted. The last organizer cannot leave.

patch.summary:
Change a member's role or display name (organizer). The last organizer of a slot cannot lose
the role.

delete.summary:
Release a claimed name (organizer): the device no longer holds it, the member keeps their
name and answers, and the name can be claimed again. The last organizer's name cannot be
released.

post.summary: Create a recovery link for a member (organizer). Accepts `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID v4 drawn by the client: a retry with the same key returns the first link with a fresh token

get.summary: The sessions of a slot in a date range, with their states.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First date, `YYYY-MM-DD` in Europe/Paris. Default: today in Paris.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
Last date, included. Default: the end of the season, or 366 days after `from` if sooner.
At most 366 days after `from`.

200.description: Sessions in the range, by date

get.summary:
One session: answers by status, guests, sessions played, call order and lineup. Its `ETag`
is the lineup version, for `If-Match` on `PUT …/lineup`.

patch.summary: Cancel or uncancel one date, or change its note, minimum, places or deadline (organizer).

put.summary:
The caller's answer, or a member's answer (organizer). Last write wins. After the deadline,
only `ko` is accepted.

200.description: The answer, with the recomputed counts and state

put.summary:
Replaces the guests of one session (organizer). A guest whose name is kept keeps their id and
lineup place, so sending the same list again changes nothing. Removing a guest who is in the
lineup removes them from it and moves its `ETag`.

200.description: The guests, in the order sent

put.summary:
Selection and pairs of one session (organizer). Needs `If-Match` with the `ETag` of
`GET …/sessions/:date`. A player plays in one game of a session at most.

member_id.description: Another member, for an organizer who answers for them. Default: the caller.

AnswerResult.description: An answer written, with the recomputed session.

name.description: `null`: a member who left, shown as "Ancien joueur".

member_id.description: A free name of the preview.

Counts.description: Answers of a session by status. `none`: active members who did not answer.

anchor_date.description: The first session, `YYYY-MM-DD`: it gives the weekday, fixed for the season.

organizer_name.description: The creator's name in the slot: they become its first organizer.

specialty.description: `gomme_creuse`, `gomme_pleine`… or a Frontis specialty id: a-z, 0-9, _ and -.

DeadlineRuleView.description: Until when players answer: `days_before` days before a session, at `time`, Paris time.

GameView.description: One game: two teams of exactly two players.

GuestName.description: A guest to keep or add, by name.

GuestsRequest.description: `PUT …/guests`: the whole list of guests of a session.

InviteCodeView.description: The invite code of a slot.

JoinPreview.description: What a player sees before joining.

list_closed.description: A closed list takes no new name: only the free names can be claimed.

next_session.description: The next session from today in Paris, `null` once the season is over.

weekday.description: ISO weekday: 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday.

Joined.description: A slot joined: the member of the device, and its token when one was issued.

player_token.description:
A new player token when the device had none, or an unknown one; also set in the cookie.
`null` when the device already had a player.

LineupView.description: The lineup of a session. A session without a lineup has version 0 and empty lists.

selection.description: Selected players, in order. A selected player outside every game waits for the next one.

closed.description: A closed list takes no new name through the invite link. Free names can still be claimed.

MeInSlot.description: The caller's member in a slot.

claimed.description: Whether a device holds this name. A free name can be claimed through the invite link.

name.description: First name or nickname: 1 to 40 characters, unique in the slot whatever its case.

NoAnswerView.description: An active member who did not answer.

ProblemDocument.description: The body of an error response.

ProblemType.description: The `type` of a problem: one per error, stable across versions.

RecoveryLink.description: A recovery link, to send privately to the member.

token.description: The token of `POST /recover/{token}`. Shown once: pik keeps only its hash.

weekday.description: ISO weekday of every session: 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday.

SeatView.description: A player of a lineup: `{"member": "m_…"}` or `{"guest": "g_…"}`.

SessionChanges.description:
`PATCH /slots/:id/sessions/:date`: absent fields keep their value, `null` goes back to the
slot's value.

cancelled.description: Cancel the date, or undo its cancellation.

deadline_at.description: Answer deadline of this date, RFC 3339.

answers.description: Answers: OK by answer time, then Dispo, then KO.

call_order.description: Member ids in the order they are called: the first `places` take the places.

SessionDetail.description: One session for the Séance and Composer screens.

SessionState.description: State of a session, computed on every read.

SessionSummary.description: One session: its effective values, state and counts.

missing.description: OK answers still needed: non-zero only when `state` is `missing`.

starts_at.description: When it starts, RFC 3339 in UTC.

SlotCard.description: A slot of the player, on the Créneaux tab.

oneOf.description: The next session from today in Paris, `null` once the season is over.

SlotChanges.description:
`PATCH /slots/:id`: absent fields keep their value. Weekday and frequency are fixed for the
season: `interval_weeks` or `anchor_date` answers 422.

SlotCreated.description: A slot created, or the one a replayed `Idempotency-Key` created.

player_token.description:
A new player token when the request came without one; also set in the cookie. `null`
when the device already had a player.

members.description: Active members, in the order they were added.

invite_code.description: Eight characters without 0, O, 1 or I, only used to join.

Conflict.description:
Name taken, list closed, session cancelled, deadline passed, last organizer, or device
already a member.

Forbidden.description:
The caller is not an organizer of the slot, or wrote with the cookie from an origin that
is not Kancha's.

Gone.description: The recovery link was used or has expired.

NotFound.description: Not found, or the caller is not a member of the slot: a 403 would tell that it exists.

PreconditionFailed.description: `If-Match` does not match the current lineup version.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or an unknown token.

Unprocessable.description:
Invalid body, parameter or header, a date that is not a session of the slot, or an
`Idempotency-Key` reused with another request.

bearer.description: Player token, for the native app

cookie.name: __Secure-pik_token
cookie.description: Player token in an HttpOnly cookie set by pik, for the website. A write with the cookie must come with an allowed Origin.
